mcqs.question: What is the definition of average power?

options.A: The work done divided by the time taken
options.B: The force applied multiplied by the displacement
options.C: The energy stored in a system per unit mass
options.D: The rate of change of momentum

mcqs.answer: The work done divided by the time taken
mcqs.explanation: Average power is defined as the total work done (or energy transferred) divided by the total time taken, i.e., P_avg = W/t. Option B describes work, C is unrelated, and D describes force, not power.

mcqs.question: Instantaneous power at a particular instant is given by which expression?
mcqs.explanation: Instantaneous power is the derivative of work with respect to time, P = dW/dt. Option B is average power, C is force times displacement (work), and D is unrelated to power.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes average power from instantaneous power?

options.A: Average power = total work/total time, while instantaneous power = dW/dt at a specific instant
options.B: Average power = force × velocity, while instantaneous power = work divided by time
options.C: Average power is measured in joules, instantaneous power in newtons
options.D: Average power applies only to rotating systems, instantaneous power only to linear motion

mcqs.answer: Average power = total work/total time, while instantaneous power = dW/dt at a specific instant
mcqs.explanation: Average power is the overall work done divided by the total time, whereas instantaneous power is the instantaneous rate of doing work, given by the derivative dW/dt. The other options mix up units or concepts.

mcqs.learning_point: Relate power to force and velocity
mcqs.question: A constant horizontal force of 10 N pushes a block that moves with a constant speed of 5 m/s. What is the mechanical power delivered to the block?
mcqs.explanation: Power = force × velocity for constant force and velocity. P = 10 N × 5 m/s = 50 W. The other options result from incorrect arithmetic or using wrong formulas.

mcqs.question: A motor does 2000 J of work in 5 s. What is the average power output of the motor?
mcqs.explanation: Average power = work/time = 2000 J / 5 s = 400 W. Option B would be 2000/8, C would be 2500/5, D would be 5000/5, none of which match the given data.

mcqs.question: A car engine exerts a constant force of 1500 N on the car. At a particular instant the car’s speed is 20 m/s. What is the instantaneous power delivered by the engine at that instant?
mcqs.explanation: Instantaneous power P = F × v = 1500 N × 20 m/s = 30,000 W. Option B uses 1500×50, C uses 1500×2, D confuses force with power.

mcqs.question: A constant force of 40 N moves an object 20 m in 4 s. What is the power delivered?
mcqs.explanation: Work done = F × d = 40 N × 20 m = 800 J. Power = work/time = 800 J / 4 s = 200 W. Option B mistakenly treats work as power, C and D use incorrect divisions.

mcqs.learning_point: Relate power to force and velocity
mcqs.question: If a machine delivers 600 W of power while exerting a constant force of 30 N, what is the velocity of the point of application of the force?
mcqs.explanation: Power P = F × v ⇒ v = P/F = 600 W / 30 N = 20 m/s. Option A would correspond to 300 W, C to 900 W, D to 1200 W, all inconsistent with the given power.
